sos.text: Jadzi, the Oracle of Arcavios, greets Lluwen and Tam at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, even as normally gentle archaics grow erratic and rampage across the plane and she seeks the cause.
Jadzi goes missing, and Kirol tells Ajani that an archaic carried her away, until Lluwen spots her in the giant archaic's palm.

The group finds Jadzi healing the wounded archaic, and she explains that archaics are oracles flung back in time after death, warns that something is threatening the future of Arcavios, and urges Chandra not to kill the archaic because that would treat the symptom and not the disease.

Jadzi tells the students to get to safety while she calms the archaic, but Tam pushes her into the churning pit of magic, and the remaining students later complete Jadzi's spell, stabilizing the archaic and halting the distortions.
